summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Posuhtik Phase 2A customer web app (Next.js 14, mobile 420px). All 10 pages load and core flows pass: OTP login (+919000000004 / 123456), dashboard greeting+cutoff+bottles=2+wallet+2 active subs+upcoming delivery, bottom nav (Home/Subs/Calendar/Bills/Profile), subscriptions list, subscription detail (modify quantity/frequency, Pause/Skip/Cancel), Skip-a-day dialog opens with cutoff validation, calendar 30-day grid with today highlighted and locked-day handling, products catalog (6 cards) with subscribe dialog (qty stepper + frequency select), invoices empty state with outstanding hero, profile (name/phone, wallet, bottles, addresses tab, Log out), orders Upcoming/History tabs. Wrong OTP shows 'invalid or expired OTP' toast. Logout clears localStorage tokens and redirects to /login. Delivery-boy login (+919000000002) succeeds and dashboard renders gracefully (empty subs/deliveries) — no crashes from 403s.

design_issues.screen: Subscription detail > Skip a day dialog
issues: Uses native browser <input type="date"> picker instead of shadcn/ui Calendar component — inconsistent UX with rest of app and limited mobile styling control. Per coding guideline, prefer shadcn Calendar+Popover.

action_items: (Optional/low) Replace native <input type=date> in /subscriptions/[id] Skip dialog with shadcn Calendar component for consistent UX.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/api.ts: NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is correctly re-exported from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via next.config — good (no hardcoded URLs).
Auth tokens stored in localStorage under posuhtik.access_token/refresh_token/user — consistent and cleared on logout.

RBAC handled gracefully: delivery-role user lands on /dashboard and queries return empty state (no crash, no leaked 403 errors in UI). Consider role-based redirect to a delivery-specific app/landing page in a future phase.
data-testid coverage: present on login + bottom-nav. Add more data-testids on subscriptions cards, product cards, modify/save/skip/pause/cancel buttons, profile logout to make automation more robust.
Skip dialog relies on native HTML date input — works but bypasses design system.
test_credentials: customer +919000000004 / 123456 (Amit Kulkarni); delivery +919000000002 / 123456 (Ramesh Patil); dev OTP 123456 universal.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded data (2 active subs for Amit Kulkarni, 1 upcoming delivery on Apr 21).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend served at https://fresh-dairy-nagpur-1.preview.emergentagent.com via Next 14 dev server (supervisor 'frontend' job, port 3000). Use mobile viewport 420x900. Login uses InputOTP with 6 slots — type the 6 digits via keyboard.type('123456') AFTER focusing the OTP input area; verify auto-submits on completion. Cutoff timer is in PASSED state (sandbox time past 20:00 IST) — expected. Tomorrow column appears locked. Profile has 'Log out' (with space) not 'Logout'. Skip dialog uses native date picker — known design deviation.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bugs found. Only one design-system inconsistency (native date picker in Skip dialog) noted as low-priority improvement.
